expected.raw_text: Know how der Generative AI, z. B. LLMs

parsed.notes:
'idealerweise in produktiven Projekten' qualifies the project context, not ML/DL, so both stay required.
OpenCV collapses into computer-vision via its alias; 'Fundierte Kenntnisse in Computer Vision' is quoted as the determining mention.
Generative AI and LLMs both map to llms and are collapsed into one criterion.
Vision Transformer is mapped to transformers (alias 'transformer'); flagged uncertain.
Model Optimization is mapped to inference-optimization as the closest entry; flagged uncertain.
Deployment under MLOps is mapped to ai-deployment; flagged uncertain.
Edge-optimization examples end in 'oder vergleichbaren Technologien', so they are read as alternatives for one ask and form group 1. Pruning is unmapped.
'oder vergleichbaren Technologien' adds no skill.
GenAI, MLOps and CV example lists are joined with 'und', so they are asked together and form no group.
'Azure oder AWS' is group 2. PyTorch/TensorFlow is a slash alternative and forms group 3.
Seniority is inferred from mentoring duty ('Fachliche Begleitung und Mentoring') plus 'Mehrjährige Erfahrung'. The title names no level, and the mentoring appears in the responsibilities section.
Degree: the guide says take the highest level named. PhD is named only as 'Promotion erwünscht' (desired), giving phd/nice_to_have, while a completed degree (bachelor) is required. This is the literal reading and is flagged for review.
'vergleichbaren Fachrichtung' widens the field only, so degree_or_equivalent is false.
